summary: Frontend-only navigation & rendering tests for Samarpan Hospital marketing site. All 20 checks passed: home page loads, header nav (About/Services/Journal) routes correctly, Services page shows exactly 8 service-detail cards, Blog list shows featured + 2 cards, all 3 blog post slugs render with multiple post-blocks, related links and back link work, home blog cards (0/1/2) navigate to correct posts, breadcrumb Home returns to /, and direct URL access works for /about, /services, /blog and /blog/<slug>.

issues: Console warning: 'motion() is deprecated. Use motion.create() instead.' Non-blocking, but should be migrated to motion.create() to be future-proof.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate framer-motion usage from motion(...) to motion.create(...) to eliminate deprecation warnings.

All navigation flows verified via Playwright using data-testid selectors defined in the review request. 3 blog slugs verified: seven-habits-that-protect-your-heart, when-a-headache-is-more-than-a-headache, the-quiet-science-of-a-good-nights-sleep.
